items.label: [Lightweight and Durable]
items.value: This travel cosmetic bag has been well- stitched and reinforced at all stress points, and the zipper opens and closes smoothly. It is lightweight and foldable, easy to carry on when traveling you can put it in your bag or suitcase. This material for our bag is the same as the products you see in exclusive stores. It's soft to touch. Easy clean-up.

items.label: [Reliable Factory]

We served the world's top 500 companies,20 years producing cosmetic bags of travel accessories. We have gone through months of choosing fabric colors to produce macaroon- coloured nylon bags by combining fashion and beauty.
